item.title: Soma 1.0 (830)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (830)

  • To-dos in notes sit closer to their text: no extra space either side of the checkbox.
  • Cortex lists notes that mention what you asked about first, newest first, so today’s note comes before one from years ago.
  • Screenshots: the search count is now labelled “Search results”.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).

item.title: Soma 1.0 (821)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (821)

  • New Screenshots space (Mac only): point Soma at your screenshots folder. Screenshots are processed through OCR and become searchable.
  • Fine tune Cortex for screenshot processing: “how many screenshots did I take in October?”, “find the screenshot with the BGP table”.
  • Share to Soma from your iPhone or iPad: New Note, New Task or Add to Note. New Task is in the Mac’s Share menu too.
  • People Hierarchy: Improved layout functionality.
  • Taller search boxes everywhere and a wider sidebar.
  • Plus quite a few other minor fixes.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).

item.title: Soma 1.0 (748)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (748)

  • Performance and feature improvements to People Hierarchy
  • Added Document Briefcase - keep track of those key documents
  • Smart Lists for People based on team
  • Fine tuning Cortex - not sure it did any good tbh
  • Auto search on any page - just type and search starts
  • Added task creation date label
  • iCloud Sync log for troubleshooting
  • plus quite a few other minor fixes.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).

item.title: Soma 1.0 (651)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (651)

  • New Hierarchy in People & Teams: drag teams onto a canvas, connect them to show who reports to whom, and add labelled boxes to group teams. Drag the background to move around; ⌘-scroll or pinch to zoom.
  • Export a hierarchy to a file and import it again, here or on another Mac. Importing adds any teams and people that are missing, and merges teams with the same name.
  • Star the people you work with often. They’re listed under Regular Contacts, and Soma suggests them first when you pick people.
  • People & Teams’ sidebar sections now open and close.
  • Edit the list of functions in Settings › People.
  • Cisco people show the Cisco logo on their card.
  • On iPhone and iPad: teams in People, a format bar above the keyboard in notes, pull down to search, and tap a note’s image to see it full screen.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
